title: DatedAsOfDate
description: Defines the dates agreed by the parties as the date of the Credit Support Annex or Credit Support Deed.

csaDatedAsOfDate.description: The date agreed by the parties as the Dated as of Date for the Credit Support Annex.

masterAgreementDatedAsOfDate.description: The date agreed by the parties as the Dated as of Date for the Master Agreement.

csaMadeOn.description: The date agreed by the parties as the Made On date of the Credit Support Deed.

additionalLanguage.description: The additional language that might be specified by the parties to the legal agreement.
